correctness.rationale: Weyl diagonalization makes 25 singular values of complete lifting exactly √5|Ag(k,ℓ)|, so κ=1/min|Ag| and σmax=√5. Every 3-subset of Z5 is affine-equivalent to {0,1,2}. At lag 2 the minimum is uw; at lag1 the five equally-spaced phases guarantee minℓ|u+w e^{iδ−2πiℓ/5}|² ≤u²+w²−2uw cos(π/5), with equality precisely fifth-root phase curvature. Setting s=uw, t=v², the completed-square bound μ≤min{s,(1−φs)/2}≤α=(5−√5)/10 is sharp iff s=t=α and indicated endpoint squared magnitudes. The remaining zero-lag Fourier coefficients have squared moduli 1, √5/5, (3√5−5)/10, all >α², so no overlooked obstruction. Two-site ambiguity lacks some lag rows. Direct real/complex Gram numerical reconstruction confirms κ=(5+√5)/2 for explicit equalizers, but global optimality comes from inequality.
